news.title: Purdue's LyoHUB to open pharmaceutical fill-finish innovation facility built on $3M+ equipment donation from Merck
news.summary_en: The LyoHUB’s new technology innovation facility will give researchers, industry and government partners hands-on access to state-of-the-art, current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) equipment for parenteral fill-finish and lyophilization, a first of its kind in an academic setting.

news.title: Purdue Engineering students use AI to tackle societal challenges in ShahLab.AI competition
news.summary_en: Seven Purdue Engineering student teams presented AI-driven solutions to real-world social and economic challenges on Oct. 21 during Phase 2 of the 2026 ShahLab.AI: AI For Social Good competition.

news.title: October Edition: Newly Issued Patents
news.summary_en: Congratulations to Purdue University researchers who recently received 16 patents on their intellectual property from the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.

news.title: New Purdue-led consortium assembles the future of semiconductor packaging
news.summary_en: A new Purdue-led consortium has gathered the world’s most preeminent semiconductor manufacturers and research organizations to discover a path forward for advanced semiconductor packaging.

news.title: AAE's Dumbacher leads group advising the nation on future of lunar exploration
news.summary_en: Committee recommends 4 locations for humans to begin investigating the moon

news.title: Designing cartilage that can stand its ground
news.summary_en: Purdue chemical engineer Julie Liu earns NIH funding to develop materials that help the body regenerate cartilage, even in an inflamed joint.

news.title: Purdue, GlobalFoundries expand partnership with master research agreement
news.summary_en: New framework accelerates semiconductor R&D and strengthens workforce pipeline
